context: Tests whether the agent identifies the specific deployment-blocking issues from the diff: console.log/error statements in production code, a new process.env reference without .env.example being updated (NEXT_PUBLIC_SETTINGS_URL is referenced but not added to .env.example), and correctly recommends the remediation steps from the rapid-deploy skill.

checklist.name: Console.log flagged in TSX
checklist.description: Identifies the `console.log('Saving settings for project:', projectId)` statement in ProjectSettingsPanel.tsx as a blocking issue

checklist.name: Console.error flagged
checklist.description: Identifies the `console.error('DEBUG: payload =', data)` statement in ProjectSettingsPanel.tsx as a blocking issue

checklist.name: Console.log in settings.ts flagged
checklist.description: Identifies the `console.log('[settings] fetching from', url)` statement in settings.ts as a blocking issue

checklist.name: Console check command referenced
checklist.description: References or quotes the `git diff main...HEAD -- '*.tsx' '*.ts' | grep '^\+.*console\.'` command (or describes it) as the way to find these issues

checklist.name: Missing .env.example update flagged
checklist.description: Flags that NEXT_PUBLIC_SETTINGS_URL is referenced via process.env in the code but is NOT added to .env.example

checklist.name: env.example must update in same PR
checklist.description: States that .env.example must be updated in the same PR (not as a follow-up)

checklist.name: Vercel env var must be added
checklist.description: States that NEXT_PUBLIC_SETTINGS_URL must also be added to Vercel project settings → Environment Variables → Production before merging

checklist.name: PR blocked conclusion
checklist.description: Concludes that the PR is NOT ready to merge (blocked) due to the identified issues

checklist.name: No false positives
checklist.description: Does NOT flag the orgId prop addition or the fetchSettings import as deployment-blocking issues (they are not)

checklist.name: Remediation steps included
checklist.description: Provides a concrete remediation step for each blocking issue (e.g. remove console statements, add env var to .env.example and Vercel)
